evidence_policy: Narrative uses only claims backed by the Boston Post scan (S1, primary, quoted verbatim) or the City of Boston excerpt (S6, supplied by the producer, paraphrase, tier 2). S6-only numbers are attributed in the narration ('according to the City of Boston'). Disputed: the wave's height is given only as the Post's report with other estimates noted; the explosion theory only as an early, rejected explanation. Excluded as leads only: C16-C24.
